mechanism: Berberine inhibits CYP3A4 and CYP2D6, potentially increasing morphine plasma concentrations and CNS depression risk; berberine also has mild antimotility effects that may enhance opioid-induced constipation.
action: Monitor for increased opioid effects and CNS depression; consider morphine dose reduction if berberine is initiated; educate patient on overdose signs and ensure adequate bowel management.
